tools.name: look_at
tools.description: Point a camera at a box seen in its wide view and zoom so the box fills the frame. Use the weapon bbox first, then the head bbox for the face evidence crop.

bbox.description: [x1, y1, x2, y2] pixels in the wide frame

tools.name: move
tools.description: Pan/tilt/zoom a camera directly. pan -140..140 deg, tilt -70..30 deg, zoom 1..4.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture what the camera sees right now and store it as evidence. subject=weapon or object sends the crop to the Analyst and returns its description. subject=face only stores the crop: it is never sent to any model. Never snapshot a benign object.

subject.description: weapon | object | face. Evidence id becomes <subject>_crop

question.description: What to ask the Analyst about the object. Never ask about a person

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Second VLM pass: check a claim about the weapon against the weapon crop (never the face crop). Call after the snapshots, before report.

claim.description: One sentence: what the weapon is

tools.name: list_cameras
tools.description: List cameras and their current pose/status. Use when a camera fails.

tools.name: report
tools.description: Finish the investigation. Call this exactly once at the end. action=ignore for benign objects, alert for a verified weapon, log otherwise.

claim.description: One sentence: what the object is

evidence.description: Evidence ids returned by snapshot, e.g. ["weapon_crop", "face_crop"]
